pageProps.seoDescription: Omniphau is a Legends of Idleon divinity god. When claiming non-candy AFK gains, also progress one of the following by the AFK time! (Refinery, 3D Printer, Cooking, Mob Breeding, Sailing, or Gaming) Minor bonus for a linked character, at most: +100% Class EXP. Blessing: +4% Divinity PTS Gain.
